{{Quote|A depiction of the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer in their battle for Sith supremacy circa 3400 BBY.|Annotation by Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Deluxe" />}}
The '''Dreamer''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who, according to legend, engaged the Sith known as the [[Monster-Slayer]] in a [[Duel between the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer|lightsaber duel]] at the [[Pits of Paxxis]] around [[3400 BBY]]. Both Sith ultimately [[Death/Legends|died]] due to the [[Gas/Legends|vapors]] of the Pits. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] annotated an illustration of the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|confrontation]] between the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer that had come into his possession.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Both died, overcome by the vapors from the Pits of Paxxis.|Annotation by Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Deluxe" />}}
[[File:LukeSkywalker-JUS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker annotated an illustration depicting the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer.]]
According to a legend of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]], the Dreamer was a Sith active around [[3400 BBY]]. At one point, they faced the Sith known as the [[Monster-Slayer]] in a [[Duel between the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer|lightsaber duel]] over the supremacy of the Sith. The [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|confrontation]] took place in the vicinity of the [[Pits of Paxxis]], with both Sith ultimately [[Death/Legends|perishing]] due to the harmful effects of the [[Gas/Legends|vapors]] of the Pits.<ref name="Deluxe" />

The duel between the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer was eventually depicted in an illustration that ended up in the possession of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="Deluxe" /> the leader of a [[New Jedi Order|new incarnation]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which was the traditional enemy of the Sith.<ref name="JediPath">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Skywalker included the illustration in a compilation of two [[Book/Legends|books]]&mdash;the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] guidebook ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''<ref name="JediPath" /> and the Sith volume ''[[Book of Sith]]''<ref name="BookOfSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>&mdash;that had been recovered by [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="JediPath" /><ref name="BookOfSith" /> In an annotation on the picture, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] also noted that the legend about the confrontation between the two Sith appeared to have a factual basis.<ref name="Deluxe" />

==Personality and traits==
Both the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and one of the two Sith had a marking on their right cheek in the form of a jagged dark line.<ref name="Deluxe" />

==Equipment==
The Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer both wielded a [[Jar'Kai/Legends|pair]] of [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. One of the two Sith wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Sith apparel|attire]] consisting of a [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]], a [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] with a hood, pants, [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and spiked [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The other Sith, besides wearing a dark tunic, pants, gloves, and boots, also donned a suit of spiked dark [[Armor/Legends|armor]], consisting of [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and leg armor pieces as well as shoulder armor combined with a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. The latter also incorporated six tubes connecting to the Sith's torso.<ref name="Deluxe" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dreamer was introduced in an art print that was included in ''[[Star Wars: The Jedi Path and Book of Sith Deluxe Box Set]]'',<ref name="Deluxe" /> a [[2014]] box set collecting<ref name="Chronicle">{{Chronicle|url=jedi-path-and-book-of-sith-deluxe-box-set.html|text=Star Wars®: The Jedi Path and Book of Sith Deluxe Box Set|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2010]] reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]<ref name="First Look">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/jedipath/index.html|text=First Look: ''The Jedi Path''}}</ref> and Wallace's [[2012]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="Amazon Box">{{WebCite|url=http://www.prweb.com/releases/starwars/bookofsith/prweb8875603.htm|text=Just in Time for New York Comic Con, Lucasfilm™ Announces the Discovery of BOOK OF SITH: Secrets from the Dark Side|date=2011-10-13|work=[http://www.prweb.com PRWeb]|archivedate=20111115030034|nolive=1}}</ref>
